productsAndServices.name: B2B2C Payouts API

productsAndServices.description: A solution enabling instant payment collection from any bank with one-click payments, supporting single and recurring debits directly on client platforms.
productsAndServices.name: B2B Payins Instant Collection

productsAndServices.description: A customizable solution for personal cash transfers and wallet reloads with tokenization of multiple cards, enabling real-time transfers and payments for services and subscriptions.
productsAndServices.name: P2P Cash In and Cash Out with Tokenization

productsAndServices.description: A service enabling fast, simple, and instant international remittance transfers integrated into client channels for global money sending and receiving.

productsAndServices.description: A digital credit service allowing businesses to purchase supplies immediately and pay later in interest-free installments through a simple online process.
productsAndServices.name: Buy Now, Pay Later Credit Service

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,000,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $16,013,192 to $16,013,192, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 56 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 53 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
